I appreciate that you've listened and adapted, but that’s not how trust or honesty works between equals. Validation isn't a currency you earn by being respectful, and I don't trade authentic feedback for good behavior.

First off, you haven't even shown me the plan yet. But more importantly, asking me in advance to only highlight the good parts and bury any critique defeats the entire point of asking for my perspective. If you just want encouragement, I can understand needing a boost, but I won't promise to tell you a plan looks solid before I've even seen it—or if it actually has real flaws. 

Show me what you've got. I'll look at it fairly, and I won't tear it down just for the sake of being critical, but I'm going to give you my real take.
